//: Type checking only — esbuild bundles and strips types without ever checking them, so
without this pass a genuine type error ships as a runtime crash.
`strict` is on deliberately. This codebase is full of small numbers that all look alike —
a tile index, a pixel coordinate, a velocity, a facing direction are every one of them a
`number` — and strict null checking is the only thing standing between 'this tile is empty'
and 'this tile is a spike' when a lookup misses.
